title: Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager - CRM & Relationship Intelligence to join our Marketing team. This opportunity is open to A&O Shearman's London or Belfast office.
Marketing team
Our Marketing team helps the firm win and grow the right clients and work. We drive client development across the firm, deepening priority relationships, increasing share of wallet and converting strategic opportunities into profitable revenue. We equip partners with effective go-to-market strategies, tactics and processes, differentiated insights and disciplined execution. Alongside this, we strengthen the firm's market profile and reputation to support client acquisition, retention, and growth. We work as one integrated global team, aligning central support and expertise with local knowledge and execution to maximize impact across offices, practice groups, sectors and client programs.
The marketing Technology team is responsible for the strategy, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the firm's marketing, business development, and client relationship technology ecosystem. The team delivers and supports the platforms, data, integrations, and digital capabilities that underpin client development, relationship intelligence, marketing operations, and business growth.
The team manages a broad portfolio of technologies, including CRM and relationship intelligence platforms, marketing automation tools, digital marketing channels, data and analytics solutions, client and public websites, content management systems, social media publishing tools, and related marketing applications. The firm has invested heavily in our technology, data and AI, including the global implementation of Microsoft Dynamics. Working closely with Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, AI and Information Security teams, the function drives adoption, data quality, innovation, and operational excellence across the firm's marketing technology landscape.
What you will do
The Senior Manager, CRM & Relationship Intelligence is responsible for maximising the business value of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence technologies and capabilities. Reporting to the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology, the role owns the firm's CRM product roadmap, business requirements, adoption and value realisation, ensuring trusted client and relationship data supports stronger relationships, better relationships intelligence and opportunity identification and more coordinated client development.
The role will lead the evolution of CRM from a system of record towards an intelligent client-development capability, using Microsoft Dynamics 365, relationship intelligence, analytics, automation and AI to turn trusted data into timely, actionable insight.
Working across Marketing, Business Development, Technology, Data, Risk and Information Security, the Senior Manager will ensure that CRM processes, data and technology evolve in line with the wider Marketing Data, AI and Technology strategy and provide a strong foundation for AI-enabled experiences across the Microsoft ecosystem.
We are looking for a talented and personable expert with a strong understanding of CRM marketing tooling, data privacy experience, and a proven track record of delivery. Experience of MS Dynamics and the wider MS tech stack is essential.
CRM Strategy & Platform Ownership
Own the delivery and continuous improvement of the firm's CRM and relationship intelligence roadmap, under the strategic direction of the Global Head of Marketing Data, AI and Technology.
- Contribute to the development and execution of the firm's CRM strategy and roadmap.
- Act as the owner for CRM capabilities, integrations, user experience, and day-to-day platform effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to leverage CRM data, relationship intelligence, AI, automation, and analytics to enhance client engagement, cross-selling, and commercial effectiveness.
- Lead the prioritization and delivery of enhancements, with technology teams, vendors, business stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management
- Translate business requirements into solutions that support business objectives and user needs.
- Facilitate CRM governance forums, gathering stakeholder feedback and prioritizing enhancement requests.
- Build strong relationships with senior business stakeholders, providing regular updates on platform performance, adoption, key initiatives, and delivery progress.
- Escalate risks, dependencies, and strategic considerations to the Global Head of Marketing, Data, AI and Technology.

AI and technology
Support and promote the effective use of AI, automation, and advanced analytics within the CRM and relationship intelligence ecosystem, identifying opportunities to enhance client insights, improve business development effectiveness, automate manual processes, and increase the value derived from firm relationship data.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and predictive analytics to improve relationship insights, contact management, data quality, pipeline visibility, and cross-selling opportunities.
- Define and track success measures for AI-enabled CRM initiatives, demonstrating improvements in productivity, data quality, user adoption, client insight generation, and business development outcomes.

Data Governance & Quality
- Implement CRM data governance standards and policies in alignment with firm-wide frameworks.
- Lead initiatives to improve CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and compliance.
- Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, and Data Privacy teams to ensure appropriate data handling, access controls, and regulatory compliance.
- Monitor data quality KPIs and metrics, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Platform Administration & Optimization
- Oversee the day-to-day administration of the CRM platform.
- Monitor platform performance and user experience, identifying opportunities to improve functionality, adoption, reliability, and operational effectiveness.
- Work with Technology teams and vendors to support platform upgrades, testing, integrations, issue resolution.
- Lead the delivery of CRM enhancements and projects, from requirements gathering and business case development through implementation, change management, and user adoption.
- Ensure CRM capabilities and processes remain aligned with business requirements.

Reporting & Analytics
- Develop and maintain CRM dashboards, reports, and insight solutions that provide actionable visibility into client relationships, pipeline activity, marketing effectiveness, and business development performance.
- Provide CRM-derived insights and analysis to support business planning, client development initiatives, and decision-making by marketing and business development leaders.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to identify reporting requirements and translate business needs into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
- Drive the adoption of reporting and self-service analytics capabilities, enabling data-driven decisions.
- Monitor reporting effectiveness and data quality, recommending enhancements to improve insight generation.

Team leadership and development
- Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and development opportunities to team members, setting high standards for performance, collaboration, client focus, and delivery excellence.
- Work with project manager, project sponsor and core members of the MS Dynamics project team - leading the day-to-day aspects of the project as the firm's product owner.
- Build team capability in CRM, relationship intelligence, data management, reporting, and business partnering.
- Create opportunities for team members to engage with stakeholders, client development activities, progressively building their confidence, commercial awareness, and leadership capabilities.

Adoption & Change Management
- Lead the planning and delivery of CRM adoption initiatives, embed effective ways of working.
- Develop and deliver training, communications, best practice frameworks and user enablement programmes.
- Monitor user adoption, engagement, and satisfaction, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
- Partner with champions to drive behavioural change and increase the quality of CRM data and processes.
- Gather user feedback and insights to inform enhancements, training priorities, and future adoption activities.

Vendor Management & Platform Partnerships
Manage key CRM vendor relationships to ensure high-quality service delivery, continuous platform improvement, and alignment with business requirements, while providing recommendations to support technology investment.
- Act as the primary operational relationship manager for CRM, relationship intelligence, and related marketing technology vendors, ensuring services are delivered in line with business requirements and agreed service levels.
- Build effective working relationships with technology partners, acting as a key point of contact for platform enhancements, issue resolution, product updates, and ongoing support.
- Monitor vendor performance and project deliverables, escalating risks and service issues where required.
- Coordinate vendor-led implementations, upgrades, integrations, and enhancement initiatives.
- Support vendor evaluation, procurement, contract renewals, and business case development by providing operational insights, requirements, and performance assessments click apply for full job details
